performance.verdict: Spend is real; leads are phantom — tracking collapse, not ad failure.

findings.text: 28-day lead count is 0 despite $916.71 Google spend and 10 recorded conversions — GHL is not receiving any lead data. Tracking is broken.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 (due 2026-08-31, overdue). Speed-to-lead automations may point at an empty seat, blocking scale-up gate.
Booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31), Review Boost campaign, Financing page, and Homer Glen branch all overdue as of 2026-08-31 — 4 milestones unresolved.
LSA re-enable (heating toggles) was due 2026-09-01 and shows no confirmed completion. LSA runs client-side but we advise — status must be verified.
GBP actions hit 0 for 7 consecutive days (2026-08-31 through 2026-09-06), a -100% delta, while paid spend continued at ~$23/day. Organic visibility has collapsed or data feed is dark.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL lead-intake webhook and Google Ads conversion tag immediately; $916.71 spent with 0 leads captured confirms a full tracking break.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 10 conversions and $916.71 spend over 28 days, but GHL shows 0 leads received — the webhook or conversion tag is broken. Pull the GHL workflow logs and cross-check the Google Ads tag firing in Tag Assistant against the last confirmed lead date. Success is confirmed when at least one inbound lead from Google appears in GHL with a correct timestamp. Resolve by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner replacing Vivian and verify their GHL login is active; this single fix unblocks the scale-up gate per SOW.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and intake ownership has been unconfirmed since the 2026-08-31 SOW deadline. Speed-to-lead automations are pointing at a potentially empty seat, which means any leads that do arrive are not being worked. Confirm the replacement contact name, verify their GHL login is active, and document after-hours coverage. Success is a named owner with a verified GHL login on file by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 7 straight days (2026-08-31–2026-09-06). Re-check on 2026-09-10 before assuming feed failure vs. real drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for every day from 2026-08-31 through 2026-09-06, a -100% weekly delta, while paid spend continued at roughly $23/day. This could be a Windsor data-lag issue (SOW flags last 2–3 days of any GBP window as unreliable) or a real organic visibility collapse. Do not act until 2026-09-10 when a full 3-day window of post-lag data is available. If actions remain at 0 on that date, escalate as a GBP listing or feed issue.
